topic: What antenna aperture size trade-offs exist between LEO and GEO satellites when optimizing gain and portability for CMOS-based ground terminals?
response: For CMOS-based ground terminals, LEO satellites require smaller antenna aperture sizes compared to GEO satellites to achieve optimal gain and portability. A 74 cm size aperture antenna is used for LEO with a 45 dB gain at 29 GHz and 42 dB gain at 19 GHz, while GEO satellites use larger apertures with 6 dB higher gain in the satellite compared to the ground terminal.
